description: Zobolin stage E step 5: the slice's ten townsfolk on their schedules, seen from the town square at noon (at work, some at the stalls) and at 22:00 (the day workers walking home to bed, the late ones still out, lit windows), the clock running at its normal speed and the weather held. Their stopwatch is npc (all townsfolk's updates each frame, with npc.level_change, npc.background, npc.lit_windows, npc.route and npc.snow_indoors); the bodies' physics shows in the physics time. With -Ablate -Kind cpu it measures the townsfolk as a whole (townsfolk: no NPCs at all, which changes the picture, so its screenshots aren't compared) and the NPC switches one by one (npc_snow_indoors, npc_close_doors, lit_windows); run with -Repeats 2. Stage E step 18 adds overhead_text: the text over the townsfolk's heads (one drawing pass with the chatter's timing inside, stopwatch overhead_text); each view keeps an exchange going between the two townsfolk nearest the camera, drawn when within 12 m.
